questions.question_text: A seed bank stores $329$ packets of vegetable seeds and $184$ packets of flower seeds. How many packets are stored altogether?

options.why: The ones-column carry was omitted when adding the tens.
The $8$ tens in $184$ were misread as $6$ tens before adding.
The two quantities were subtracted instead of combined.

questions.question_text: A theatre printed $940$ tickets and sold $365$. How many tickets were not sold?

options.why: The tens column was not reduced after lending one ten to the ones.
The hundreds column was not reduced after regrouping one hundred.
Each pair of digits was subtracted larger minus smaller without regrouping.

questions.question_text: A coastal track is $834$ m long and a forest track is $597$ m long. How much longer is the coastal track?

options.why: After using $600$, the adjustment of $3$ was subtracted instead of added back.
The $5$ hundreds in $597$ were treated as $4$ hundreds.
Each column used the larger digit minus the smaller digit without regrouping.

questions.question_text: A choir has learnt $462$ lines of a $700$-line performance. How many lines remain to be learnt?

options.why: The known amount was added to the target instead of finding the gap.
The $6$ tens in $462$ were treated as $5$ tens when subtracting.
The $2$ ones were added instead of subtracted: $700-400-60+2=242$.

questions.question_text: Three classes donated $175$, $208$ and $147$ pencils. How many pencils did they donate altogether?

options.why: The carry of $2$ tens from the ones-column total of $20$ was omitted.
The carry into the hundreds column was omitted after adding the tens.
Only the first two class totals were added; the third was left out.

questions.question_text: A hall had $1250$ chairs. Staff brought in $386$ more and removed $429$. How many chairs were then in the hall?

options.why: Only the first step was completed, so the removed chairs were not subtracted.
The removal was subtracted from the starting amount and the delivery was ignored.
Both changes were added, so the removed chairs increased the total.
